coffees.name: Single Origin Espresso
coffees.description: Pulled at 9 bars of pressure with precise 28-second extraction. Delivers a viscous caramel crema, bright mandarin acidity, and a lingering bittersweet cocoa finish.

coffees.name: Velvet Cappuccino
coffees.description: Double ristretto shot enveloped in silky microfoam steamed to exactly 65°C. Flawless symmetry of dark espresso punch and natural milk sweetness.

coffees.name: Artisanal Café Latte
coffees.description: Rich espresso poured over textured whole milk, adorned with hand-poured free-pour rosetta latte art. Warm, enveloping, and comforting.

coffees.name: Long Black Americano
coffees.description: Double espresso extracted directly over 92°C reverse-osmosis filtered water. Preserves delicate volatile aromatics and golden crema ring.

coffees.name: Valrhona Dark Mocha
coffees.description: Melted French Valrhona 70% dark chocolate ganache blended into freshly extracted espresso and velvety steamed milk, topped with raw cocoa dust.

coffees.name: 24-Hour Nitro Cold Brew
coffees.description: Steeped for 24 continuous hours in cold ambient temperature, then keg-conditioned and infused with pure food-grade nitrogen for a cascading Guinness-like head.

foods.title: Artisanal Wood-Fired Pizza
foods.subtitle: 72-Hour Fermented Sourdough
foods.description: Slow-fermented sourdough crust blistered at 900°F in our stone oven. Layered with San Marzano tomato reduction, fresh fior di latte mozzarella, artisanal crisp pepperoni, and hot chili-infused honey.

foods.title: Truffle Brioche Smash Burger
foods.subtitle: Double Angus Beef & Smoked Gouda
foods.description: Two smashed prime Angus patties with crispy lacy edges, smoked gouda, balsamic caramelized onions, and house black truffle aioli on a toasted buttered brioche bun.

foods.title: Prosciutto & Burrata Panini
foods.subtitle: Grilled Artisan Ciabatta
foods.description: Aged 18-month Prosciutto di Parma, creamy Pugliese burrata, wild baby arugula, and heirloom tomato pesto pressed hot between golden toasted sourdough ciabatta.

foods.title: Roasted Garlic Herb Batard
foods.subtitle: Whipped Confit Butter
foods.description: Crusty rustic baguette infused with sweet roasted garlic cloves, parmigiano-reggiano, fresh Italian parsley, and sea salt flakes.

foods.title: Rosemary Truffle Pommes Frites
foods.subtitle: Hand-Cut Double Fried
foods.description: Hand-cut Idaho russet potatoes double fried to golden perfection, tossed with white truffle oil, grated pecorino, and garden rosemary.

foods.title: Espresso Bean Tiramisu & Fondant
foods.subtitle: Dark Roast Valrhona Confection
foods.description: Savoiardi biscuits soaked in our house ristretto and aged rum, folded into silky mascarpone cream and finished with melted molten dark chocolate core.
